verdict.rationale: Blink provides secure SSH and Mosh access to remote servers. It supports Ed25519/ECDSA/RSA keys, saved hosts, tunnels (-L), ProxyCommand and ssh-agent, and connections that persist across networks and device sleep, which covers generic secure remote access. Nothing in the evidence shows Kubernetes cluster access or broader infrastructure-access features beyond SSH. Missing for 10: Kubernetes cluster access (kubectl/kubeconfig or similar), identity-based infrastructure access across resource types, and independent corroboration of secure access patterns.
